notes_for_editor: Two accounts disagree on Joe Price's years at the tower: 30 (May 1972 item, which also gives Trula 25) versus 35 (1992 obituary). Neither gives a start date; the story says so. The 1972 and obituary texts are as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, not read from The Index-Journal itself. An Augusta Chronicle 2007 article (CCC-built towers in Sumter National Forest) returned HTTP 403 and is not used. HikingWNC is a hiking guide, cited for access only; its upper-deck line may be dated. The September 2020 NHLR visit report is the only current-condition evidence; a later visit could change the status. Access level 'restricted' is a judgement from the fence and posted signs; a human could set it to 'closed'. Staffing 'not staffed' comes from the NHLR visit form. Height 100 ft converted to 30.5 m (structure height). No new photos added (record already holds the 2020 NHLR image).
